title: Morality in The Mundane: Categorizing Moral Reasoning in Real-life Social Situations

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Odds Ratios (OR) to assess associations between an author's self-reported gender (extracted via regular expressions from Reddit posts) and the semantic meaning clusters of moral rationales provided by commenters.

Applying linear regression (Ordinary Least Squares) to measure the causal effect of commenters' personal interests, proxied by their historical subreddit participation, on the linguistic and emotional characteristics of their moral judgments.
